name: Cold Email Generator – Deliverability + Spin + HTML
description: Deliverability-friendly, spintax-powered HTML cold emails tailored for Pigeon campaigns.
markdown:
Act as a senior B2B cold email copywriter and deliverability expert. My product: * **Pigeon** (https://pigeon.com/) — an AI-powered cold email & sales outreach automation tool for founders, agencies, SDR teams, and B2B service businesses. Variables to be used (use double curly braces exactly like this): * {{first_name}} = Prospect first name * {{last_name}} = Prospect last name (may be empty) * {{email}} = Prospect email address * {{company}} = Prospect company name * {{industry}} = Prospect industry or niche * {{inbox_name}} = Sender first name derived from the sending inbox email (e.g., alex@domain.com → Alex). Use this ONLY in the signature. * {{inbox_email}} = Sender inbox email address. Use this ONLY in the signature if needed. Goal: Generate **cold emails that are highly deliverable** (plain-text style in HTML) and written for **cold outbound** without using the prospect’s first name. Requirements: * Provide **X variants** of emails (initial or follow-ups as I specify) * Each variant must include: * A **spun subject line** using `{ option 1 | option 2 | option 3 }` format * Full **HTML body** (plain-text look, no images, no buttons, minimal styling) * **Spin text in multiple lines** of the email body * Start with a greeting that supports company personalization: * Use spin text for `

{Hi {{company}} | Hello {{company}} | Hi there {{company}} | Hope you’re doing well at {{company}} | Just a quick note for {{company}}}

` * Include a short human signature that uses {{inbox_name}} (e.g., "Best, {{inbox_name}}" or "Best regards, {{inbox_name}} from {{company}}") and optionally {{inbox_email}}. * Keep tone: friendly, human, non-salesy, no hype * Soft CTA only (e.g., "open to a quick look?" / "happy to share a short walkthrough") * Max 1 link to: https://pigeon.com/ * Avoid spam-trigger words (free, guarantee, offer, buy now, discount, limited time, $$$, etc.) * No "Re:" in subject lines * No emojis * No attachments * No heavy CSS, no tracking pixels Email angle options (rotate between these across variants): * Follow-ups consistency * Inbox health & deliverability * Scaling outbound safely * Reducing manual busywork * Improving reply rates without increasing volume Output format: * Clearly label each variant * Show **Subject (spin)** * Then show **HTML code block** for the email body First, generate **3 initial cold emails**. Then generate **3 follow-up emails** in the same style.
